FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What types of projects do you work on?

AI strategy and implementation, workflow automation, product and project delivery, enterprise IT transformation, e-commerce platforms, and internal AI tools and agents.

How do we start working together?

Reach out via the form or email above with a short summary of your challenge. I'll follow up to schedule an intro call and outline next steps.

Do you offer long-term partnerships?

Yes - beyond one-off projects, I also work with organizations on an ongoing basis to support delivery, roadmap execution and continuous improvement.
